value.rationale: The balanced bidirected biclique has natural order-72 symmetry and directed cycle obstructions. The complete 9-class table and multiplicity-free degree-3/4 decompositions answer a natural equivariant topological question not implied by existing nonequivariant ranks, and show a one-dimensional quotient homology class while degree-four invariants vanish. A motivated exact structural result rather than a routine special case of a known module theorem.
